parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
Serialization view for the task item. When omitted, defaults to **`extended`** for this API version.

- **`compact`** — `id` and `title` only.
- **`normal`** — standard shape without extended-only ...

title.description: Short title of the task item. Omit to leave it unchanged; it cannot be set to a blank value.

number.description: Identifier for the task item, unique within the project (compared case-insensitively). Omit to leave it unchanged; send a blank value to have the next number assigned.

description.description: Detailed description of the work. HTML markup is sanitized.

due_date.description: Date and time the task item is due.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the task item.

task_item_category_id.description: ID of the company task item category to associate with the task item. Send an empty string to clear it.

private.description: Restricts the task item to its creator, assignees, and distribution members. Project admins and users with view-all permission on Tasks can still see it.

assigned_id.description: ID of the user to set as the primary assignee. Ignored when `assignee_ids` is supplied.

assignee_ids.description: IDs of the users to assign. IDs that are not valid assignees on the project are dropped without error; the first ID that remains becomes the primary assignee.

distribution_member_ids.description: IDs of the users to place on the task item's distribution list.

prostore_file_ids.description: IDs of existing Procore files to attach to the task item.

attachments.description:
Task Item attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the response

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the response

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the response

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the response

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach to the response

document_management_document_revision_id.description: PDM document to attach to the response
